name: corpus
description: Connect saved questions and relationships to their exact current sources.

interface.shortDescription: Read current sources with saved context
interface.longDescription: Corpus connects saved questions and relationships to the files, email records, and earlier Codex or Claude conversations they came from, then opens the exact current sources needed now. Registered originals remain unchanged; indexes and saved context stay on this Mac. Archived contexts remain readable, and permanent deletion is not available.
capabilities: Selected views without private source links
defaultPrompt: Show my saved Corpus contexts and their connected material.
Find the relevant context and open the exact current sources I need.
Show which Corpus sources informed this answer.
